main_editor_blank.description: A blank GNOME Text Editor window is open with an empty document area. The top bar shows Open, New Document, Save, and a main menu button, along with standard window controls.

main_menu_open.description: The main GNOME Text Editor window is visible with the application menu open as a popover. The menu shows theme choices, zoom controls, and commands including Preferences, Keyboard Shortcuts, Help, and About Text Editor.

preferences_appearance.description: The Preferences dialog is open on the Appearance section, showing theme choices and editor appearance toggles. A close button is available in the title bar, and there is a row for Custom Font with a disclosure button.

preferences_appearance_custom_font_expan.description: The Preferences dialog remains on the Appearance section, but the Custom Font row is now expanded to show the selected font value, Monospace 11. Additional appearance toggles are visible below.

font_picker_dialog_open.description: A font selection dialog is open on top of the Preferences window, showing a searchable font list, preview text, size controls, and Cancel/Select actions. The underlying Appearance preferences are partially visible but blocked by the modal dialog.

elements.name: Preview text
elements.value: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

preferences_appearance_font_selected.description: The Preferences dialog is open on the Appearance page after returning from the font picker. Custom Font is enabled and expanded, now showing the selected font as DejaVu Sans Mono 11, with additional appearance toggles visible below.

elements.name: Markdown preview
elements.value: # Markdown … Links https://gnome.org … Preformatted Text … Emphasis … Combined … Block quotes too!

preferences_appearance_collapsed_font.description: The Preferences dialog is open on the Appearance section. The custom font row is collapsed again, and appearance theme choices plus three editor display toggles are visible.

main_editor_blank_returned.description: The main GNOME Text Editor window is visible again with a blank untitled document and no menus or dialogs open. The top bar offers Open, New Document, Save, and the main menu, while the editor area is empty.

open_recent_popover_empty.description: An open-recent popover is displayed from the Open button over the blank editor window. The popover contains a search field and shows that there are no recent documents.

file_open_dialog.description: A native file chooser dialog is open for selecting a file to open in Text Editor. The sidebar shows common locations and the main file list is currently empty for the selected Recent view.

file_open_dialog_home.description: The native file chooser is open in the Home location, showing one visible folder named gui_distillation. Encoding and file type dropdowns are available at the bottom along with Cancel and Open buttons.

file_open_dialog_home_folder_selected.description: The native file chooser is open in the Home directory with the folder gui_distillation selected in the file list. Sidebar locations, navigation controls, encoding and file type dropdowns, and Cancel/Open buttons are visible.

file_open_dialog_home_folder_opened.description: The native file chooser remains open in the Home directory, showing the gui_distillation folder in the file list and sidebar. The folder row is no longer highlighted, so it appears the previous click opened or deselected it without changing directories.

file_open_dialog_home_with_up_navigation.description: The native file chooser is still open in the Home directory. A breadcrumb/header now shows the current location as user1 with back and disabled forward navigation, while the file list still contains the gui_distillation folder.

file_open_dialog_other_locations.description: The native file chooser is open on the Other Locations view. It shows local computer storage information and a Connect to Server section with a server address field, while file-opening controls remain at the bottom.

file_open_dialog_computer.description: The native file chooser is open in the Computer/root location, showing top-level system folders in the file list. Sidebar locations, breadcrumb navigation, encoding and file type dropdowns, and Cancel/Open controls are visible.

main_editor_blank_again.description: The main GNOME Text Editor window is visible again with a blank untitled document and no popovers or dialogs open. The top bar shows Open, New Document, disabled Save, the main menu, and window controls.

main_menu_open_with_file_actions.description: The main GNOME Text Editor window is visible with the application menu open. This expanded menu includes theme selection, zoom controls, and additional file/edit/help commands not previously explored, such as New Window, Save As, Find/Replace, Print, and Document Properties.

document_properties_dialog.description: A Properties dialog is open over the blank GNOME Text Editor window. It shows file metadata and document statistics for the untitled draft, with a close button in the dialog header.

main_editor_blank_post_properties.description: The main GNOME Text Editor window is visible with a blank untitled document and no menus or dialogs open. The top bar shows Open, New Document, disabled Save, the main menu, and window controls.
